assessments.name: PART A: Lesson Sequence and Presentation
assessments.description: In groups you will develop and present a lesson sequence for a student on the Autism Spectrum.

assessments.name: PART C: Lesson Sequence and Presentation Q&A
assessments.description: Immediately following the 10-minute presentation, your group will engage in a 5-minute Q&A with the tutor about the content of your presentation.
assessments.type: Q&A following presentation, submission or placement

assessments.name: PART B: Lesson Sequence and Presentation
assessments.description: Following receipt of feedback from Part 1, group will present lesson sequence to the class.

assessments.name: Strategy or Practice Critique
assessments.description: A detailed examination and review of a strategy or practice used to assist students on the Autism Spectrum.

assessments.name: Teacher Resource Portfolio
assessments.description: You will compile and critique a set of artefacts and/or resources that can be used to support the education of students on the Autism Spectrum.
